result.topic_en: Notes on the chromatic aberration of a system of two infinitely thin lenses separated by a distance a: formulas for the combined focal length, principal point and focal point, their changes for less refrangible rays, and the condition for the focal point to be achromatic.

also $f = \frac{AB}{A+B-a}$, $E = N - \frac{Ba}{A+B-a} = N - \frac{af}{A}$
$F = E + f$

$\Delta f = \frac{ff}{AB}\left((B-a)\alpha + (A-a)\beta\right)$
$\Delta E = \frac{aff}{AB}\cdot\alpha - \frac{aff}{AAB}(A-a)\beta$
$\Delta F = \frac{ff}{A}\cdot\alpha + \frac{(A-a)^2}{AAB}ff\cdot\beta$
Soll also $\Delta F = 0$ werden, so muss $\beta = -\frac{AB}{(A-a)^2}\cdot\alpha$
sein, wodurch zugleich
$\Delta f = -dE = -\frac{af}{A-a}\cdot\alpha$ wird
Es wird ferner für jene Stellung
$\frac{d\,\frac{\Delta f}{f}}{da} = \frac{f(B+a-A)}{B(A-a)^2}\cdot\alpha$ | $\frac{\partial\,\Delta F}{da} = \frac{aff}{A(A-a)}\alpha$
